title: Research Methods in Psychology (Jhangiani, Chiang, Cuttler, and Leighton)
institution: LibreTexts remix of the Kwantlen Polytechnic University Pressbooks edition
description: Open undergraduate research-methods textbook: 1 The Science of Psychology; 2 Overview of the Scientific Method; 3 Research Ethics; 4 Psychological Measurement (understanding measurement; reliability and validity; practical strategies); 5 Experimental Research (experiment basics; experimental design; experimentation and validity; practical considerations); 6 Non-Experimental Research; 7 Survey Research; 8 Quasi-Experimental Research; 9 Factorial Designs; 10 Single-Subject Research; 11 Presenting Your Research; 12 Descriptive Statistics; 13 Inferential Statistics.
rightsNotes: LibreTexts book and section pages (2026-10-31): 'is shared under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license and was authored, remixed, and/or curated by Rajiv S. Jhangiani, I-Chant A. Chiang, Carrie Cuttler, and Dana C. Leighton via source content that was edited to the style and standards of the LibreTexts platform.' The book page's source tag is https://kpu.pressbooks.pub/psychmethods4e (the KPU fourth edition).
LibreTexts terms of service (effective 10/15/2020): 'Content can be downloaded or copied consistent with the licensing of the material.' They say nothing about AI or automated access.
The KPU Pressbooks original returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher and was not opened; this record verifies the LibreTexts remix only.
